youtube_title: Bank Not Closing Your Credit Card? It Owes You Rs 500 a Day. Rules You Didn't Know #11 #Shorts
youtube_description:
RULES YOU DIDN'T KNOW #11. You asked to close your credit card and the bank keeps pitching offers. How long does the bank get? A: as long as it wants. B: only 7 working days.
Answer: B. Under RBI's Master Direction on credit and debit cards (2022), if all your dues are paid, the issuer must close the card within 7 working days. If it's late, it pays you Rs 500 for every day of delay until the card is closed. You can ask via email, helpline, app or website - keep proof. Not resolved? Complain to the RBI Ombudsman at cms.rbi.org.in.
Education only, not financial advice.
Source: RBI Master Direction - Credit Card and Debit Card Issuance and Conduct, 2022.

Credit card band karwana hai aur bank bole 'sir, bas ek offer sun lo' 🙄 Hafton se band hi nahi ho raha?
A: bank jitna time chahe. B: sirf 7 working days.
Sahi hai B ✅ RBI 2022 rule: saare dues clear hain toh 7 working days mein card band karna hi hai. Late kiya toh bank TUMHE ₹500 har din dega, jab tak band nahi hota.
Email, helpline, app — kahin se bhi request do, proof rakho. Bank na sune toh RBI Ombudsman (cms.rbi.org.in).
